facts.text: Maria started volunteering at a homeless shelter about a year ago after witnessing a family struggling on the streets.

evidence.quote: I started volunteering here about a year ago after witnessing a family struggling on the streets. It made me want to help, so I reached out to the shelter and asked if they needed any volunteers.

facts.text: Maria's volunteer work at the homeless shelter has been a fulfilling experience for her.

evidence.quote: It has been a really fulfilling experience for me since then.

facts.text: A resident named Cindy wrote a note expressing gratitude for the support received at the homeless shelter.

evidence.quote: One of the residents at the shelter, Cindy, wrote it. It's a heartfelt expression of gratitude and shows the impact of the support they receive.
